title: Links
summary: Text can link to any page, to a single block, or to an item in the library.

stories.as: someone writing about ideas that cross fields
stories.want: to link ideas wherever they connect
stories.soThat: the book shows how the topics relate

stories.as: someone who writes about what they read
stories.want: to link from my pages to the papers, posts and threads in my library, and to see from an item where I wrote about it
stories.soThat: what I read and what I think of it stay connected

requirements.text: A block's text can link inline to any page.
A block's text can link to a single block on any page.
A link still reaches its target after the target is moved.
A block's text can link inline to any item in the library; the link shows the item's current title and opens the item.
While a link is being made, each library item offered names the pages that already link to it.
A library item's screen lists the pages that link to it, each opening the page at the block that holds the link.
